name: Smart Green Infrastructure Monitoring Sensors - Historical

columns.name: Measurement Title
columns.description: Full title description of measurement, including name of location and measurement description.

columns.name: Measurement Description
columns.description: Description of the type of sensor providing the reading.

columns.name: Measurement Medium
columns.description: Whether the measurement pertains to the atmosphere or soil.

columns.name: Measurement Time
columns.description: Time the Measurement Value relates to in Central Daylight Time (UTC -5).

columns.name: Measurement Value
columns.description: Value related to the sensor reading, in units expressed in "Units" column.

columns.name: Units
columns.description: The named-units describing the numerical units in "Measurement Value".

columns.name: Units Abbreviation
columns.description: Commonly accepted scientific abbreviation of the "Units" column.

columns.name: Measurement Period Type
columns.description: Whether "Measurement Value" indicates an instantaneous or cumulative reading.

columns.name: Data Stream ID
columns.description: An identifier for the measurement type and location.  All records with the same value should be comparable.

columns.name: Resource ID
columns.description: An identifier for the resource providing the data.  Within a Data Stream, the specific resource may change over time, even while providing comparable data.

columns.name: Measurement ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for the record, within all records produced by the Data Stream.  The same Measurement ID could exist in two or more Data Streams.

columns.name: Record ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each record in the dataset.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the sensor providing the measurement in WGS84 coordinates

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the sensor providing the measurement in WGS84 coordinates

columns.name: Location
columns.description: Latitude and Longitude of the sensor providing the measurement in WGS84 coordinates.
